description: Main React component for the front-end of a simple shopping platform. Contains components for displaying a header, product cards, and loading product data via fetch API calls.

methods.name: Header()
methods.description: Functional component rendering the header section with a title and navigation buttons.

methods.name: ProductCard({ title })
methods.description: Functional component to display individual product cards with a title and an 'Add to Cart' button.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main functional component managing state for products, loading, and error, and rendering the overall app UI.

methods.name: loadProducts
methods.description: Asynchronous handler to fetch product data from backend API and handle loading/error states.
